name: Akechi Mitsuhide
source:
A former retainer of Oda Nobunaga who rebelled against him.
He twice beat the eastern army Nobunaga leads.
A really smart guy with great ingenuity, but he's cold and calculating.
Koujirou's view: 'He used to be a kind and gentle person'.
